title: Baked Pilchard Gratinee with Jewelled Rice
description: A hearty Italian-inspired dish featuring pilchards baked in a gratin with a side of jewelled rice. Perfect for a cozy dinner with family and friends.
instructions: In a large skillet, sauté the polish sausage and garlic until browned.
In a separate saucepan, combine the milk, cream, and parmesan cheese. Heat over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the cheese is melted and the sauce is smooth.
Add the pilchards, herbal seasoning, and cooked sausage mixture to the saucepan. Stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with additional parmesan cheese.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is golden brown and bubbly.
While the pilchard gratin is baking, prepare the jewelled rice according to package instructions.
Serve the pilchard gratin over the jewelled rice and enjoy!
Cook the butter in a pan until it has melted and it has a nice golden brown color.
Add the melted butter to the pilchard gratin and sprinkle with parmesan cheese.
Return the pilchard gratin to the oven and bake for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
